findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The SOQL query is constructed using string concatenation, which can lead to SOQL injection if the searchKey is not properly sanitized.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries or escape the searchKey to prevent SOQL injection.

findings.title: FLS violation on Opportunity.Amount
findings.explanation: The code updates the Opportunity.Amount field without enforcing Field-Level Security (FLS) checks.
findings.remediation: Remove the Amount field from the SOQL query or enforce FLS checks before updating the field.

findings.title: Excessive permissions in permission set
findings.explanation: The permission set allows read access to Opportunity.Amount, which is not necessary for the intended purpose.
findings.remediation: Remove the read permission for Opportunity.Amount from the permission set.

findings.title: FLS not enforced on Lead.Status
findings.explanation: The code updates the 'Status' field on a Lead without enforcing Field-Level Security (FLS). This could allow users to set the status to any value, bypassing FLS checks.
findings.remediation: Use the Schema.SObjectType.Lead.fields.Status.isUpdateable() method to enforce FLS before updating the field.

findings.title: Excessive permissions in permission set
findings.explanation: The permission set grants excessive permissions such as 'ModifyAllData' and 'ViewAllData', which are not necessary for tier-1 support agents.
findings.remediation: Remove unnecessary permissions such as 'ModifyAllData' and 'ViewAllData' from the permission set.

findings.title: Missing Sharing Enforcement
findings.explanation: The class is declared without sharing, which means it will bypass the sharing rules and FLS checks, potentially exposing data to users who should not have access.
findings.remediation: Add the sharing enforcement by removing 'without sharing' from the class declaration or explicitly enforce sharing rules within the class.

findings.title: Excessive Profile Permissions
findings.explanation: The profile allows read access to the Contact object and its fields, which is more permissive than necessary for a guest user profile.
findings.remediation: Revise the profile permissions to only allow necessary read access to the Contact object and its fields for guest users.
